title: Universal highly arc transitive digraphs
exact_target: Can an infinite digraph with at least one arc have all finite directed-path symmetries and finite degrees while every two arcs communicate through an alternating walk? The accompanying question concerns the absence of a homomorphism onto the directed integer path.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 3302 (OPG-677). CC BY 4.0.
Open Problem Garden, Universal highly arc transitive digraphs, node 677, original problem page. Original question and full discussion.
